name: Yuting He
evidence: Could not identify the source paper, so no anchor exists. Searched arXiv API (cross-cultural / cultural sentiment title and all-field queries) - no hit; alphaXiv discover_papers returned only unrelated cultural-alignment and cross-cultural emotion papers; Semantic Scholar, Crossref and Europe PMC APIs were unreachable from this environment. WebSearch on the exact quoted title 'Evaluation and Optimization of Large Language Models for Cross-Cultural Sentiment Analysis' surfaced no such record, and a WebSearch pairing the topic with "Yuting He" and "Jie Liu" returned no paper listing those authors. Without a confirmed paper there is no institution, lab or co-author anchor; 'Yuting He' is a common Chinese name with many distinct researchers (medical imaging, robotics, NLP), so any profile match would rest on the name alone. Reported not_found per the namesake rule. | RESOLVED THIS ROUND (source paper identified; person still unresolvable). The paper was NOT missing - its identifier was in the repo's own seed all along (research/seed/cdeval_pool.json): DOI 10.1109/AIETA69357.2026.11508902, '2026 International Conference on AI in Education Technology and Applications (AIETA)', 2026, exactly two authors (Jie Liu, Yuting He). Confirmed via the S2 paper endpoint, which also returns the abstract (cross-cultural sentiment analysis benchmarking Qwen-plus, GPT-5.2 and GLM-4-plus over 100 English abstracts - so almost certainly a China-based group). S2 returns NO affiliations, openAccessPdf is empty, the paper is not indexed by web search, and ieeexplore.ieee.org / doi.org are blocked by this environment's network policy, so the affiliation block is unreachable from here. Additionally, the S2 author entity is almost certainly a mis-link: authorId 48479399 ('Yuting He', DBLP ['Yuting He', 'Yuting He 0001'], 46 papers) is a MEDICAL IMAGING researcher - vessel re-identification, RGB-event tracking, gaze-assisted medical SAM, MRI contrast-enhancement, PET-to-CT generation - with no NLP or cross-cultural work besides this one AIETA paper. Attributing that person's contacts to this row would very likely be wrong, so nothing was assigned. BLOCKER IS ENVIRONMENTAL, NOT EVIDENTIAL: fetching the IEEE Xplore page for DOI 10.1109/AIETA69357.2026.11508902 from a network that permits ieeexplore.ieee.org would very likely print both authors' affiliations and resolve this row. | DATA DEFECT CONFIRMED THIS ROUND - same failure as row 135, on the same paper. A direct Semantic Scholar query on paperId c060dd2d49d9fb1fa93eb8028b710083bb11f75b shows S2 author 48479399 'Yuting He' carries TWO DBLP identities in one record: externalIds.DBLP = ['Yuting He', 'Yuting He 0001'] - a bare DBLP name and a numbered homonym are distinct DBLP person records, so this entity too merges different people and cannot carry contacts. The IEEE paper itself (2026 International Conference on AI in Education Technology and Applications, DOI 10.1109/AIETA69357.2026.11508902) is unreachable from this environment - ieeexplore.ieee.org and doi.org are both blocked by the egress proxy, the work is not on arXiv, and Semantic Scholar returns an EMPTY affiliations array for both authors, so no organisational anchor exists for either of them from any reachable source. NO SEARCH BUDGET WAS SPENT on this row, deliberately, for the same reason as row 135: with no affiliation and a conflated author entity every candidate profile would fail the namesake rule by construction. RECOMMENDATION to the parent session: handle as a table defect alongside rows 109, 135 and 138; only the printed IEEE affiliation block could rescue it.
